data.long_meaning: Tildy is an Old English name derived from the Old English words 'tig' meaning 'war' and 'leoda' meaning 'people'. This name was given to a warrior or someone who led a group of people in battle. The name Tildy carries the meaning “Battle-ready” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tildy usually hope their child will grow to embody battle-ready and live with faith, good character and purpose.
